subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI tracker remain open as the umbrella for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical items after the reply-metadata PR and final-fallback contract are resolved?
rationale: Current main only partially solves the report, and the remaining work crosses Control UI request shape, runtime context, and final delivery semantics where product ownership and landing order matter.

options.title: Keep This As The Control UI Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open until structured Control UI reply metadata and final no-output presentation have a single maintainer-approved resolution path.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move reply metadata to the runtime-context/reply contract and no-output behavior to the final-fallback/UI rendering issues, then close this only after those links preserve the Control UI-specific gap.

options.title: Close After Reply PR Lands
options.body: Treat the no-output half as already tracked elsewhere and close this once the structured reply metadata work lands, accepting that this issue will not remain the combined tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep This As The Control UI Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until structured Control UI reply metadata and final no-output presentation have a single maintainer-approved resolution path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent cross-surface history in agent runtime and Control UI chat behavior, and is one of the people explicitly mentioned in the issue timeline.
